name: Hyakki Yakou ~Kaidan Romance~
original_name: 百鬼夜行～怪談ロマンス～
source:
Oumagatoki's sister game.

The heroine, Tatsuta Ui, is a dragon god princess, who’s #1 in the school and uses fire. She’s half god and half youkai, and tries to live up to her royal lineage at school, but secretly feels hemmed in.

[From [url=http://lijaka.com/blog/2012/04/news-bs-log-may-2/]Lijakaca's blog[/url]]
